component.name: Stream Vault
component.summary: Watch your downloaded courses, series and movies with progress tracking

description.p: Stream Vault is a local-first desktop app for watching downloaded courses, TV series and movies. It scans your folders into libraries, tracks per-item progress, plays video in a built-in player, and lets you take timestamped notes.
Internal media server, six-theme engine, animation toggle, and new top-bar navigation.
